name: Tech Vortex Career Roadmap Catalogue
purpose: Canonical career roadmaps used by the personalized roadmap engine.

personalizationRule.description: Career tracks define target skills. Confirmed profile skills are skipped from active learning. Developing skills are surfaced for reinforcement. Job requirements and skill goals are merged as additional requirements and prioritized.

machine-learning-ai.name: Machine Learning / AI
machine-learning-ai.description: A progressive path from programming and data foundations through classical ML, deep learning, deployment, and MLOps.

data-science.name: Data Science
data-science.description: A data-centric path covering analysis, statistics, visualization, machine learning, and communication.

full-stack.name: Full-Stack Development
full-stack.description: Frontend-to-backend web development with databases, security, testing, deployment, and system fundamentals.

backend.name: Backend Development
backend.description: Server-side engineering covering APIs, databases, security, testing, deployment, scalability, and distributed systems.

cloud-devops.name: Cloud / DevOps
cloud-devops.description: Infrastructure and delivery path from Linux and networking through cloud, containers, orchestration, IaC, and observability.

iot-embedded.name: IoT / Embedded Systems
iot-embedded.description: Embedded programming, microcontrollers, communication protocols, sensors, edge computing, and IoT systems.

dsa-problem-solving.name: DSA & Problem Solving
dsa-problem-solving.description: Shared algorithmic foundation for technical interviews and software engineering.

software-engineering.name: Software Engineering Fundamentals
software-engineering.description: Cross-career engineering practices that improve reliability, maintainability, collaboration, and delivery.

resourcePolicy.officialDocumentation: Prefer first-party/maintainer documentation. Conceptual topics may use authoritative educational references where no software vendor documentation exists.
resourcePolicy.youtube: Use a high-view verified video when web research exposed reliable view counts. Do not present missing view counts as verified popularity.
resourcePolicy.fallback: Use youtubeSearchUrl when no verified video is stored; do not invent a video ID.

implementationNotes: Use skill names as canonical IDs only after passing them through the existing skill normalizer/ontology.
Do not duplicate the same resource object into each career track; store by canonical skill and reuse.
The roadmap engine should remove confirmed skills from active learning but retain them as completed prerequisites.
Job-description requirements should be layered on top of the selected career track rather than replacing the track.
Resume-derived unconfirmed candidates must not satisfy requirements until confirmed by the user.
A roadmap item should expose prerequisites, official documentation, YouTube resources, and future practice/verification fields.
